result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading indicator appears stuck over a restaurant image that otherwise seems loaded.

issues.description: The first card under “Popular right now” shows a large loading spinner centered over the restaurant image, even though the image and card content are already visible. This makes the card look unfinished or stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading spinner once the image/card content has loaded, and ensure the image loading state is cleared correctly for cached or partially loaded images.
